mapper.sql: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.note, s.manual, s.estimated, t.id AS task_id, COALESCE(c.display_title, t.title) AS title, t.work_item FROM work_session s JOIN task t ON t.id = s.task_id LEFT JOIN yunxiao_timer_task c ON c.task_id = t.id
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS task_id, COALESCE(c.display_title, t.title) AS title, t.work_item FROM task t JOIN work_session s ON t.id = s.task_id LEFT JOIN yunxiao_timer_task c ON c.task_id = t.id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_recent_task h WHERE h.task_id = t.id)
GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY MAX(s.started_at) DESC, title
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (title) VALUES (#{title}) ON CONFLICT (title) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM task WHERE title = #{title}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task WHERE id = #{taskId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM yunxiao_auto_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_auto_effort (task_id, day, revision) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{day}, lower(hex(randomblob(16)))) ON CONFLICT (task_id, day) DO UPDATE SET revision = excluded.revision
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET work_item = #{workItem} WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: WHERE s.started_at < #{rangeEnd} AND s.ended_at > #{rangeStart} ORDER BY s.started_at, s.id
SELECT morning_start, morning_end, afternoon_start, afternoon_end FROM work_schedule WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_schedule (id, morning_start, morning_end, afternoon_start, afternoon_end) VALUES (1, #{morningStart}, #{morningEnd}, #{afternoonStart}, #{afternoonEnd}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET morning_start = excluded.morning_start, morning_end = excluded.morning_end, afternoon_start = excluded.afternoon_start, afternoon_end = excluded.afternoon_end
mapper.select: SELECT session_id FROM scheduled_session WHERE day = #{day}

SELECT placement.position, s.task_id, SUM(s.ended_at - s.started_at), s.note, s.estimated FROM scheduled_session placement JOIN work_session s ON s.id = placement.session_id WHERE placement.day = #{day} GROUP BY placement.position, s.task_id, s.note, s.estimated ORDER BY placement.position
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_session WHERE id IN (SELECT session_id FROM scheduled_session WHERE day = #{day})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_session (session_id, day, position) VALUES (last_insert_rowid(), #{day}, #{position})
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(c.display_title, t.title) FROM work_session s JOIN task t ON t.id = s.task_id LEFT JOIN yunxiao_timer_task c ON c.task_id = t.id WHERE s.id <> #{sessionIdToIgnore} AND s.started_at < #{endedAt} AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > #{startedAt})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scheduled_session placement WHERE placement.session_id = s.id)
ORDER BY s.started_at LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_session (task_id, started_at, ended_at, note, estimated, manual) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{note}, #{estimated}, #{manual})
mapper.update: UPDATE work_session SET task_id = #{taskId}, started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, note = #{note}, estimated = #{estimated} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
